description: Found 2026-09-14 while grokking selective receive for 8b. runtime/src/park.rs:21-23 states the matcher allocates nothing and cites check_pure_codegen, which does not exist anywhere in the tree. Violations: fz_bs_reader_init_ref allocates a 3-tuple on process->heap (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:1287-1300) and is called from the matcher (native_codegen/receive.rs:1103); the interpreter's guard evaluation can allocate a UTF-8 binary on the SENDER's heap at probe time (src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:451-467). Heap asymmetry: JIT (src/exec/runtime.rs:203) and interp (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:282) run the receiver's matcher against a message still in the sender's heap while passing the receiver's *mut Process; AOT deep-copies into the receiver first (aot_shim.rs:535-542). Nothing records whose heap a matcher may touch. Also: receive.rs module doc (lines 4-17) omits the process parameter of MatcherFn. Resolution path: the per-function purity fact planned for 8b (no allocation, no process) becomes the enforced contract for everything the matcher runs; projection helpers that allocate must stop allocating or leave the matcher; the doc states the heap rule per door.
title: Matcher purity contract is asserted, unenforced, and violated; whose heap at probe time is per-door
